injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.
Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Monday's game against the Kings, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
Fox is questionable for Monday's game against the Kings due to a right shin contusion, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
McLaughlin (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Kings.
Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.
Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
